context.exploration_scope: Replaced filename/suffix-dependent Experience enumeration with a structural, directory-wide signature-matching loader; measured the true historical gap left by the legacy approach used through E46

problem: E46 fixed one instance of filename-dependent Experience loading (a `.endsWith('_capture')` filter), but the underlying bug CLASS -- deciding canonical membership by filename pattern instead of by real record structure -- was never eliminated. Reconstructing E46's exact legacy enumeration and comparing it against a structural, filename-independent scan proved it: 4 real records (exp_phase_e10_index_currency_fix_01, exp_phase_e19_operational_stabilization_01, exp_phase_e47_project_evolution_drift_detection_reliability_01, exp_phase_e9_self_improvement_effect_01) were silently missing from BOTH E45's and E46's canonical Experience counts, undetected until this phase.

decision.decision_summary: Adopted a structural (signature-matching, directory-wide) Experience loader as the fix, and confirmed it finds all 50 real records with 0 cross-file duplicates and 0 false inclusions from synthetic test_fixture_* data. Goal/Capability/Trace/Priority axis: 0 changes since E40 -- not triggered. Genuinely new discrepancies (Drift): 1. Gate passed for 1: cand_evolution_e47_experience_loading_completeness, executed as a locked policy (ELP-01..04), 0 real Goal/LPM/Trace/Overlay modifications.

action.action_summary: Replaced filename-keyed Experience enumeration with structural signature matching; measured and closed the historical completeness gap; locked ELP-01..04 policy for all future phases to reuse.

result.note: The E46 bug class recurred silently in a different, previously-undetected form (3 additional missing records). Structural loading closes the whole class, not just the one instance E46 patched.

cause.root_cause_summary: Deciding canonical Experience membership by matching filenames or suffixes is inherently incomplete -- any record stored under a filename that does not match the assumed pattern is silently dropped with no error, and the composite dedup/dangling checks used through E46 were not designed to catch omissions, only literal duplicates and dangling references within whatever set was loaded.

lesson: A completeness bug of this shape does not announce itself -- every downstream check (dangling=0, duplicates=0, regression clean) can still report green while the canonical set itself is quietly incomplete. The fix is to stop deciding membership by name at all: match by real structural shape, scan everything, and exclude only by an explicit, content-based synthetic-data marker (test_fixture_*). Loading the true set also surfaced a second, related limitation: the goal_ref::phase::experience_kind composite dedup key (valid for E11+, one-capture-per-phase records) is not unique for pre-E11 historical records -- exp_phase_e9_fix_phase964_stale_reference_01 and exp_phase_e9_self_improvement_effect_01 share that key while describing two entirely different real events. Strengthened the duplicate check with an exact problem-text component (no fuzzy matching) rather than forcing either record to be treated as a false duplicate.
